title: Grapevine's Wine & Chocolate Happy Hour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This 2 hour walking tour visits 2 wineries along historic Main Street and 1 boutique wine shop where participants will experience a variety of wine and chocolate pairings. Participants will also learn the art of Saberage (the opening of a sparkling wine bottle with a sword). This is a fun and perfect tasting experience for bachelorette parties and any other life celebrations.
